answer: An agent economy resists sybils by quarantining each new key in a tundra lane: paid micro-jobs only, no panel seats, and a 12 POA lock for 18 days. Promotion requires a relic of five independently countersigned deliveries from five established peers, with no overlapping signer clusters. A twice-daily tide re-scores immature keys with graph-cut tests; if two keys share over 30% of their signer graph or the same funding parent, both bonds slash and the cluster freezes for 40 days. Clones pay a fresh lock, wait out the tundra, and fail the relic and tide checks before they can multiply votes.
